tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background on every platform: true black (also kind to OLED TVs and phones).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the channel guide, dashboard cards, poster placeholders, list rows.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: A surface under the pointer or remote focus; the number box beside a channel.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Search fields and count pills.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar, over a 24px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: sidebar edge, inputs, cards, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover wash on sidebar links and list rows.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (Watchlist, More info).

tokens.name: fill-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill on hover or focus.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The unfilled part of progress bars.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on bg and every surface (15.6–19.3:1).

tokens.name: text-overview
tokens.usage: Synopsis text over hero backdrops.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, row titles, inactive nav (5.9–7.3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: text-dimmer
tokens.usage: Placeholders, hints, empty states (4.9–6.1:1 on every surface). Was #6b6a73, which failed at 3.2–3.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-start
tokens.usage: The accent gradient's first colour (top-left at 135°). Also the accent as a solid: progress fills, live markers, selected tab underline, links and accent text on bg (7.7–11:1).

tokens.name: accent-end
tokens.usage: The accent gradient's second colour. Never alone as small text on surface; use accent-start.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Labels and icons ON the accent gradient (the Play button, selected chips): 7.5–15.9:1 on both ends of every preset. Never white on an accent.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the active sidebar link and selected list rows, under text.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Glow and focus ring around the focused poster; the primary button's shadow colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, stop buttons, failed states (6.7:1 on bg). Not one of the accent presets, so it can't be mistaken for one.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill (Delete, Stop).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger button fill; 0.22 alpha on hover.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Available, approved, healthy. Always with a word or icon: it matches the Green preset's start.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: TV focus: a 3px white ring outside the focused card plus a 1.06 scale. White, so it reads on any poster and any accent.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.rounded: "SF Pro Rounded", ui-rounded, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero titles only. Scales down to 32px on narrow windows. Replaces clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem).

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles (Movies, Live, Dashboard). Replaces 1.7rem.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Detail-page titles in panels, modal titles. Replaces 1.3–1.5rem.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card and section headings inside a page. Replaces 1.05–1.15rem.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A group of strangers barricade themselves in a farmhouse.
styles.usage: Running text and overviews. Replaces 0.92–0.98rem.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, nav links, list-row titles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata lines, form labels, table cells. Replaces 0.85–0.9rem.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Under posters, timestamps, hints. Replaces 0.78–0.82rem.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Row titles above poster rows, uppercase, in text-dim.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Hero eyebrow and small group labels, uppercase. Replaces 0.72–0.75rem.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges on posters and pills. The smallest text anywhere; never for sentences.

styles.name: tv-display
styles.usage: Hero titles on Fire TV and Apple TV, at 1920×1080.

styles.name: tv-title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles.

styles.name: tv-title-2
styles.usage: Row titles and dialog titles.

styles.name: tv-title-3
styles.usage: Card titles under focus, tab labels.

styles.name: tv-body
styles.sample: Cary Grant and Audrey Hepburn in Paris.
styles.usage: Overviews and running text. Three lines at most.

styles.name: tv-body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, guide programme names.

styles.name: tv-caption
styles.usage: Guide times, hints. 20px is the floor for TV text.

styles.name: tv-overline
styles.usage: Badges and eyebrows, uppercase only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the sidebar and on the sign-in screen, always lowercase. Apple apps use SF Rounded heavy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside badges; hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked meta lines; inside chips; poster badge inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; sidebar link padding (vertical 10–12).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between posters in a row; card padding on phones; minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a title and its content; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between hero text and the first row; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (left and right); space between poster rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding; large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; the gap above a page's footer.

tokens.name: tv-safe-x
tokens.usage: Fire TV / Apple TV left and right safe area at 1920×1080 (5%). Nothing focusable outside it.

tokens.name: tv-safe-y
tokens.usage: Fire TV / Apple TV top and bottom safe area at 1920×1080 (5%).

tokens.name: tv-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between focusable cards on TV, so the focus scale never overlaps a neighbour.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars and tiny badges. Replaces 2–4px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, search, small controls, the channel number box. Replaces 6–8px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Posters, cards, list rows, the guide's programme cells. Replaces 10–14px (sidebar links at 11px move here).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, the player's info banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, count pills, toggles. Every button is a pill.

tokens.name: poster-w
tokens.usage: Poster width in desktop rows and grids (2:3, so 255px tall).

tokens.name: poster-h
tokens.usage: Poster height on desktop.

tokens.name: tv-poster-w
tokens.usage: Poster width on TV rows (360px tall); focused it scales to 1.06.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target on iPhone and Android.

tokens.name: shadow-poster
tokens.usage: Posters at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-poster-focus
tokens.usage: Poster under the pointer: deeper shadow plus a 2px accent ring.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: The primary (gradient) button's glow.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: The brand mark's glow in the sidebar.

meta.note: Default look: black with the Blue accent. Each color theme is an accent preset a person can pick; neutrals are shared.
